settings.heading: Clinical Formulation & Efficacy
settings.content: Engineered with cold-pressed botanical bio-actives and lipid barrier reinforcements. Documented to boost barrier moisture retention by 94% within 14 consecutive days of morning and evening ritual.

settings.heading: Key Bio-Actives & Full INCI
settings.key_bioactives: Phyto-Squalane 5%, Cold-Pressed Rosehip Seed Oil, Niacinamide (Vitamin B3), Micro-Algae Ferment, Hyaluronic Acid.
settings.content: Aqua/Water/Eau, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Rosa Canina (Rosehip) Seed Oil, Squalane, Niacinamide, Glycerin, Sodium Hyaluronate, Tocopherol (Vitamin E), Pelargonium Graveolens Oil, Rosmarinus Officinalis Leaf Extract.

settings.heading: Conscious Ritual & How to Use
settings.content:
Morning Ritual: Warm 2–3 drops between clean palms. Inhale the natural botanical terpene profile. Press gently into cleansed face, neck, and decolletage using upward sweeps until absorbed. Follow with SPF.

Evening Ritual: Apply 3–4 drops following treatment essences as an intensive overnight lipid sealant.
